name: Odfjell SE
summary: Odfjell SE engages in the provision of services for the transportation and storage of bulk liquid chemicals, acids, edible oils, and other specialty products in Norway. It operates through Chemical Tankers and Tank Terminals segments. The company owns and operates chemical tankers that offer global and regional transportation; and tank terminals, which provide storage of various chemicals and petroleum products. As of April 10, 2026, it operates chemical tanker fleet of 72 vessels, including 38 owned, 9 bareboat, 22 time chartered, and 3 pool vessels.
